quizTitle: Conditionals: As long as / Unless / Until — The Value of Things

questions.question: Something only has real value ___ it improves someone’s life in some way.
We won’t realize how valuable time is ___ it’s almost gone.
Money means nothing ___ you use it for something meaningful.
A friendship isn’t truly valuable ___ it’s based on trust and respect.
You can keep your sense of peace ___ you stop comparing yourself to others.
We won’t appreciate the small things ___ we slow down and notice them.
You can call something valuable ___ it adds meaning, not just price.
We can’t understand the value of kindness ___ we’ve needed it ourselves.
A lesson isn’t wasted ___ you learn something from it.
You won’t feel truly rich ___ you learn to be content with what you have.
We won’t see the value of mistakes ___ we stop being afraid of failure.
Your skills will remain valuable ___ you keep learning and adapting.
A relationship can’t grow ___ both people make an effort.
You won’t find the real value of a gift ___ you see the thought behind it.
An experience remains valuable ___ you remember what it taught you.
We can enjoy technology ___ we don’t let it replace real connection.
You can’t measure someone’s value ___ you look beyond what they own.
We won’t feel fulfilled ___ we align what we do with what we value.
You won’t see how valuable honesty is ___ you lose someone’s trust.
You can keep your dignity ___ you stay true to your principles.
